newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves two key rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves two key rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal offered to inject 40 billion escudos of seven-day funds into the money market in a variable rate repo and left two key rates unchanged when it announced the terms for its new cash reserves accounting period which starts on Monday.
The central bank's rate for draining funds remains at 5.40 percent while its emergency lending rate for up to 100 billion escudos of one-day funds to resident banks stands at 7.40 percent.
The Bank of Portugal last injected funds at 5.70 percent.
